mapper.select: SELECT b.material_id AS "materialId", b.batch_no AS "batchNo", b.expiry_date AS "expiryDate", m.code AS "code", m.name AS "name", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) FROM wms_stock s WHERE s.material_id = b.material_id AND s.batch_no = b.batch_no) AS "qty" FROM wms_batch b JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = b.material_id WHERE b.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND b.expiry_date <= #{before} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_stock s WHERE s.material_id = b.material_id AND s.batch_no = b.batch_no AND s.qty > 0) ORDER BY b.expiry_date
